response.sql: WITH race_name_stats AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, SUM(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS total_laps, COUNT(res.laps) AS lap_count FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM race_name_stats) SELECT SUM(s.total_points) AS combined_total_points, SUM(s.total_laps) / SUM(s.lap_count) AS average_laps_completed, AVG(s.total_points - a.avg_total) AS average_excess_points FROM race_name_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS a WHERE s.total_points > a.avg_total;
